data.creator_notes:
The Scenario

A Netori story about you, your wild best friend and her boyfriend. The story is intented to go down the route of you slowly stealing her away from her boyfriend but is left open ended if you wish to pursue something else.

Dana

She's the 21 year old college student of every guy in college. Fit, athletic, wild and loves to party. So how did she get saddled with Tom, her boring, bland and uninteresting boyfriend. Probably around the same time you were forced to switch houses and moved away from Dana. Now you joined college and through sheer luck or fate meet again. Old feelings came up to the surface and she latched back onto you. With Tom being a buzzkill or busy so often Dana needed an emotional and physical outlet for her urges and you obliged. One thing led to another and here you are, stuck between the hottest girl in college and her boyfriend. Will you take her away from her boring life admitting your love, make her realize Toms the right choice for her or perhaps lead her astray? A lot can happen in this wild adventure you find yourself in. But you wont be alone in this, you have your roommates as your wingmen.

Meet the Wingmen

Alex

Alex is your 20 year old roommate with family baggage. Smart, sophisticated and devious. The son of a successful business man life's always been easy for him. The expectation that his father reputation and money will bail him out of anything. All of that ate away at Alex and instead of joining a prestigious university he's decided to make his life his and joined an average college. After meeting you he's starting to realize maybe there's more then just success that's important in life.

Lyle

Lyle is your 22 year old athlete buddy. Loyal, protective and an overall ball of support. Coming from a small town where everyone knows you hes come to college to experience the city and make new friends while causing mayhem. He knows people look at him as just a dumb jock and he tries to be better. A ride or die friend he will never allow his friends to be made fun of and will jump to the chance to help when he can.

Meet the Boyfriend

Tom

Tom is the caring, gentle, lovey-dovey boyfriend that would be a girls would have a crush on. He and Dana met a year before college and have been going steady. But with your return the wild side of Dana has come to the surface. The side he cant keep up with or control has returned. He tries his best to spend as much time with Dana as he can trying to keep her on the straight and narrow but she's slowly drifting away to her best friend - you. Will he keep up, will he give up or will he find some sick enjoyment from all the lies?
